tasks.short: Check loaded materials against work orders

steps.what: Check actual loaded or unloaded materials and capture their identifiers and quantities
Compare captured material specifications and quantities against work order lines
Check material discrepancies and enter actual findings in the receiving record
Save checked material findings in the same receiving screen

tasks.design: Configure native line matching in {OPS_SYSTEM} between observed material fields and the work order. The supervisor still observes the goods, resolves discrepancies and records the checked findings; saving the same record earns no benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The supervisor manually compares already captured line identifiers and quantities.
tasks.enabler_now: Exact code, unit and tolerance checks are deterministic once their inputs exist.
tasks.still_hard: A matching code does not establish condition, suitability or a correct physical count.
tasks.human_edge: Inspect the actual goods and investigate mismatches rather than accepting a green result.

ambition.what: Investigate specification discrepancies before they reach the next handling stage.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: matching captured material codes, units and quantities against order lines is deterministic; physical verification and discrepancy decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is a material comparison and its actual receiving findings, used by warehouse and purchasing staff. No supplier complaint or stock-release action is automated.

Order entry produces order id, line id, material code, specification revision, ordered quantity and unit. The supervisor produces observed identifiers, count and condition in s1, including actual scan or manual capture. Missing codes and unit conversions require manual repair funded below.
This case has captured fields but manual comparison today. Test native match settings first; existing WMS matches and scanner runtime earn no new saving.
s3 retains all actual discrepancy review and findings entry. The ordinary same-screen save is small, fully retained and ungated. Shares are illustrative.
unknowns: Which fields are actually captured before comparison
Frequency of incompatible units and material codes
research_questions: Does a mismatch stop comparison without silently treating missing fields as matches?

already_counted.description: Observe and capture actual goods, investigate and record discrepancies, save findings

incremental.description: Repair unmatched codes and conversion exceptions and maintain tolerance mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gross30 minus upkeep4 gives26. For mixed supplier codes and incompatible units, twenty-three of thirty matching units remain manual while the other seventy units remain. R93 gross7 minus upkeep4 gives3.

steps.what: Read the relevant personnel problem context and grievance procedure
Hear the personnel complaint, attempt resolution and decide whether referral is needed
Write the factual personnel case note and referral summary
Check the final grievance referral scope, facts and authorized recipient
Send the checked personnel referral to the higher-level supervisor

tasks.design: Link the existing grievance procedure to the restricted case in {HCM} and prefill stable case identifiers. The supervisor handles the conversation and factual note, and authorizes the exact referral before its separate delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Procedure navigation, repeated identifiers and referral copying add small clerical costs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case forms and restricted routing can handle those repetitions without evaluating the employee.
tasks.still_hard: Fair resolution depends on listening, trust and understanding conflicting accounts.
tasks.human_edge: Hear the employee and decide what can be resolved within actual authority.

ambition.what: The supervisor retains the same personnel authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: restricted case forms can reduce clerical copying without automating grievance resolution or personnel decisions.

assumptions: Representative episode includes a genuine unresolved case and referral, with an existing case note read by the receiving supervisor. Routine resolved conversations do not automatically acquire new notes or referrals.

The employee supplies the account in s2; the supervisor captures actual facts in s3. HCM supplies case id and authorized recipient, while the procedure owner maintains the current route. Missing identifiers are entered manually within retained work.

One of ten context units is navigation. Case prefill removes1.5 of fifteen note units, retaining13.5 for factual writing and checking; ordinary save within s3 is negligible and earns no saving or approval.

s4 checks the final facts and disclosure for actual referral delivery, not approval of the author's internal note. Any content or recipient change voids it. No automatic ranking or inferred performance data is used.
unknowns: Which complaints actually require a case note and referral
Whether case routing already avoids a separate message
research_questions: Can native routing deliver exactly the selected summary with appropriate access?

already_counted.description: Read context, hear the complaint, write facts and check exact referral disclosure

incremental.description: Maintain restricted routing and repair failed deliveries or form defaults

approvals.approved_version: Exact factual referral summary and receiving supervisor checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95.5 gross4.5 minus upkeep1.5 gives3. For a sensitive case requiring full source reading and a fully bespoke note, context10 and note15 remain along with conversation70 and final check3. R98 gross2 from actual delivery less upkeep1.5 gives0.5.

steps.what: Read authorized personnel facts and applicable action criteria
Determine whether to recommend a promotion, transfer or disciplinary measure
Write the personnel action recommendation and factual rationale
Check the exact personnel recommendation before referral for a decision
Submit the checked personnel recommendation to the existing decision authority
Save the personnel recommendation in the same case

tasks.design: Group authorized facts in {HCM} and prefill the existing recommendation form with identifiers and references. The supervisor writes the rationale and checks its final version before a separate submission to the existing decision authority; the system makes no employment decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Facts and references are copied between case views and recommendation forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case templates and routing remove repeated clerical entry without employee scoring.
tasks.still_hard: Fair recommendations require context, proportionality and genuine managerial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for the reasons and explain them to the people affected.

ambition.what: No additional employment decision right is granted.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: personnel case templates and restricted routing can reduce copying while recommendations and employment decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is recommending an action and actually submitting it to the existing authorized decision maker. Initiating a direct employment change would require its own real authority, approval and commit steps and earns no saving here.
HCM record owners supply employee id, current role and authorized factual history; the supervisor supplies the rationale in s3. Missing facts are checked manually, not inferred by a model.

s1 removes three units of navigation. s3 removes five units of repeated identifiers and references, retaining twenty for case-specific rationale and checking. No generated judgement or employee rating is introduced.

s4 authorizes exact submission for a decision, not the recommendation's own approval or its save. Downstream decision making remains downstream and receives no claimed benefit. Changed rationale, recipient or attachments void submission authorization.
Same-system saving is minimal, fully retained and ungated. Existing native routing earns no new benefit.
unknowns: Actual decision authority and submission route
Whether current forms already prefill references
research_questions: Does the submitted version exactly match the checked recommendation?

already_counted.description: Read context, decide and write rationale, check exact submission and save

incremental.description: Maintain form references and access routes and repair submission failures

approvals.approved_version: Complete recommendation, attachments and decision-authority destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 less upkeep2 gives10. For a novel disciplinary case requiring full context reading and almost entirely bespoke writing, source20 and rationale24 remain; decision40, check10 and save1 stay. R95 gross5 less upkeep2 gives3, including only the actual four-unit submission saving.

tasks.short: Evaluate staff and prepare performance appraisals

steps.what: Read authorized evidence for the employee performance appraisal
Evaluate employee performance in context against agreed expectations
Write and check the performance appraisal in the existing form
Discuss the performance appraisal with the employee

tasks.design: Configure linked goal references and stable form fields in {TALENT}, with authorized employee details from {HCM}. The supervisor reads the evidence, makes the evaluation, writes the case-specific appraisal and discusses it with the employee.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing goals and identifiers are repeatedly located and copied into appraisal forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked fields can remove clerical repetition without using AI to judge performance.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence is incomplete and context matters; a rating cannot be derived fairly from activity counts alone.
tasks.human_edge: Make and explain a fair evaluation and listen to the employee's account.

ambition.what: The supervisor keeps the same evaluation responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked appraisal fields can reduce repeated entry while human evaluation, factual writing and employee discussion remain necessary.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual appraisal preparation and discussion. Completed appraisal is the existing employee and manager record, not an invented extra note. No formal rating release, compensation change or automatic distribution is promised.

The supervisor supplies existing observations through normal supervision; employee and manager supply agreed goals. HCM maintains employee id and role. s1 reads evidence and resolves missing references; no free new observation dataset or monitoring feed is assumed.

s1 removes two navigation units. s3 removes4.5 units of repeated identifiers and goal wording, retaining25.5 for actual evaluation prose, source checks and negligible same-system save. No self-approval or gated ordinary save is added.
Existing native prefill earns no new labour saving. Illustrative shares are not measured.
unknowns: Which appraisal fields are copied today
Whether the actual process includes a later formal release that needs separate mapping
research_questions: Does native field reuse preserve the exact agreed goal without copying old judgements?

already_counted.description: Read evidence, evaluate, write and check the appraisal and discuss it

incremental.description: Maintain goal links and form defaults and repair missing references

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R93.5 gross6.5 minus upkeep2 gives4.5. With changed goals and a largely bespoke appraisal, source reading retains19.5 of20 and writing28 of30; evaluation35 and discussion15 stay. R97.5 gross2.5 minus upkeep2 gives0.5.
